context: A boss reviews a strategic outlook with his deputy
purpose: Teach: 展望/要約/謝罪/かかわる/生み出し/係る/もたらし/行なっ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今期の戦略展望をまとめたから、まず要約から確認しよう。
lines.en: I've put together this quarter's strategic outlook, so let's start by reviewing the summary.
lines.style: Authoritative boss opening a serious strategic meeting.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、拝見しました。新規事業が大きな価値を生み出していますね。
lines.en: Yes, I've read it. The new business is generating significant value.
lines.style: Respectful deputy responding with professional analysis.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: そうだ。あの部署は去年も大胆な改革を行なっただろう。
lines.en: That's right. That department also carried out bold reforms last year.
lines.style: Confident boss recalling past achievements with pride.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ただ、コンプライアンスに係る費用が予想より膨らんでおります。
lines.en: However, the costs related to compliance have ballooned beyond projections.
lines.style: Careful deputy raising a delicate financial concern.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: それは現場の信頼にかかわる問題だ。軽視できんな。
lines.en: That's an issue that affects trust on the ground. We can't take it lightly.
lines.style: Grave boss acknowledging the seriousness of the problem.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 先月の不備については、取引先へ正式な謝罪文を送付済みです。
lines.en: Regarding last month's lapse, we've already sent a formal apology letter to the client.
lines.style: Methodical deputy reporting on completed remediation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: よし。あの判断が思わぬ追加契約をもたらしたのは皮肉だな。
lines.en: Good. It's ironic that decision ended up bringing in unexpected additional contracts.
lines.style: Reflective boss noting an unexpected positive outcome.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 来週の役員会では、この展望を踏まえた具体策を提案いたします。
lines.en: At next week's board meeting, I'll propose concrete measures based on this outlook.
lines.style: Determined deputy committing to forward action plan.
